settings.title: Settings
settings.chunkSizeDescription: Set the number of images to process at once. Too many will consume memory.
settings.fetchDictionaryDescription: Fetch the latest custom node definitions from online. If disabled, bundled dictionary will be used. Changes will take effect on next startup.
settings.includeAllSamplers: Include parameters from all samplers in tags
settings.includeAllSamplersDescription: When off, only parameters from the first executed sampler will be added to tags. Turn on if you want to record all parameters from complex workflows (refine, upscale, etc.).
settings.debugModeDescription: Output detailed debug logs to console. Useful for diagnosing issues.
settings.skipCacheDescription: When enabled, cached metadata will not be used. Always fetch fresh metadata from images.
settings.reportIssueDescription: You can report issues or improvement suggestions on GitHub. Click to open the GitHub Issue creation page.
